summary: Tested contact form dual behaviour: DB save + mailto client trigger. Backend POST /api/contact returns success and persists message. Frontend form submits successfully, toast 'Kiitos viestistäsi!' appears, form is reset (indicating code reached lines AFTER window.location.href = mailtoLink). Admin page /admin/viestit2043409503 correctly shows submitted messages. Mailto URL string could not be intercepted at runtime (Chromium native Location.href setter is non-configurable via prototype override, and no external mail handler is registered so no navigation event fires), but source review confirms exact spec compliance: recipient=info@mittalinja.fi, subject=Lomake, body includes Nimi/Email/Puhelin/Viesti with CRLF (%0D%0A). Since toast+form-reset both execute AFTER the mailto assignment line, the mailto call is guaranteed to execute.
passed: POST /api/contact returns 200 with success:true and Finnish confirmation message
MongoDB persists submissions (count increased 2 -> 5 across test runs; name/email/phone/message all stored correctly)
GET /api/contact/messages returns list including new submissions with formatted timestamp
Contact form UI renders on landing page (#yhteystiedot section)
Playwright form submission: fields fillable, submit button clickable, toast 'Kiitos viestistäsi!' displayed
Form fields reset to empty strings after successful submission (proves mailto line executed since it precedes reset)
Admin page /admin/viestit2043409503 lists submitted messages including latest 'Playwright Tester' entry with correct email, phone, and body
action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider using window.open(mailtoLink, '_self') or an <a> click for better testability and to survive strict Content-Security-Policy environments; current implementation is functionally correct.

notes.mailto_capture_limitation: Playwright/Chromium does not fire framenavigated or request events for mailto: scheme, and Location.prototype.href setter cannot be overridden (non-configurable). Behaviour was validated indirectly via successful post-mailto code execution (toast + form reset) plus source review.
notes.credentials_file: /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required for this test scope
